name: v0.6.0
body:
## Changes

### Features

- Clone version cards: create independent cards sharing the same binaries
- Clone with settings option: duplicate card with customization, config link, and override
- Safe-delete: version files are only removed when no other card shares the install path

### UI / UX Improvements

- Gear icon dropdown menu on version cards with Clone, Clone with Settings, and Delete actions

### Maintenance

- Removed UNIQUE constraint on installed_versions table to support multiple cards per build
- Removed migration system (app not yet public)
